description: Architects Registration Board - New Registration & Renewal of Chartered Architects for the year 2019/2020
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the registration and renewal of registration for Chartered Architects, Architects, and Architectural Licentiates by the Architects Registration Board. This constitutes the official registration and licensing of professionals for business/commercial practice, which falls under the Commercial category (Type 6) for business registrations, commercial permits, and professional licensing/certification.
